descriptions.w3d_k11b_swap_value_802f778c: Appears to exchange a small-data global with a new value and return the previous value.
descriptions.w3d_k11b_clear_pair_802ffcf8: Appears to zero a two-word record, first word then second.
descriptions.w3d_k11b_clear_pair_802f9f64: Appears to zero a two-word record, second word then first.
descriptions.w3d_k11b_raise_flag_80300c18: Appears to set a small-data flag word to 1.
descriptions.w3d_k11b_copy_first_word_803096a4: Copies the first word of a source block into the word at offset 12 of a record.
descriptions.w3d_k11b_get_field_14_8030a080: Returns the word at offset 20 of a record.
descriptions.w3d_k11b_get_half_80314840: Returns an unsigned halfword small-data global.
descriptions.w3d_k11b_get_field_88_80314bd4: Returns the word at offset 136 of a record.
descriptions.w3d_k11b_get_field_84_80314fd8: Returns the word at offset 132 of a record.
